The substance of averments made in all the Petitions are as under:
That on 13.02.2020 at about 6.15 a.m., when the husband of the Petitioner No.1 in MVC No.3727/2020 by name Lokesh L., was riding his Two wheeler bearing Reg.No.KA-06-HA-1887 along with Petitioner No.1 and 2 as a pillion riders from SCCH 15 5 MVC No.3727, 3726 & 3733/2020 Tumakuru side towards Kunigal side and when they reached near Banavara Gate, S.H-33, TM Road, Hebburu Hobli,

Due to the accident, deceased Lokesh L., Petitioner No.1 and 2 fell down and had sustained grievous injuries and deceased Lokesh L., had died at the spot.

6. Immediately after the accident, the dead body of the deceased Lokesh L., was shifted to District Hospital, Tumakuru wherein the doctor has conducted postmortem and handed over SCCH 15 6 MVC No.3727, 3726 & 3733/2020 the dead body to the petitioners.
